items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Benny -- it really started around -- in the early '50s... Later then, after Cootie {Williams} had joined the band, he asked me if I wanted to join the band.

ctx.x: Well, actually, I worked with Benny -- it really started around -- in the early '50s. Maybe -- you know, I could have joined Benny's band when I was with Basie's band. I started to. Later then, after Cootie {Williams} had joined the band, he asked me if I wanted to join the band. And maybe through John, John might have -- but he always dug me, you know, because I remember one time, I told Benny this, too, we broadcast from the Hotel Sherman. I think it was the Panther Room. and Benny heard the broadcast. He said,…
So when I told Benny, Benny said, "Well, hell, you wasn't working for me, you was working for him." I said, "But you said I was a good tenor player." He said, "That's it."
